full_prompt_en: The image is a square minimalist graphic illustration built from black, warm off-white, and a single vivid red. A solid black side profile of a person occupies most of the left and center. The forehead, nose, lips, and chin are cut as a crisp negative-space boundary against a red circular disk behind the face. The disk sits left of center, and part of its curve is hidden by the black silhouette. Near the lower right, a black hand holds the thin stem of a small plant upright. Several pointed black leaves branch from the stem. One tiny red circular flower or berry sits near the upper leaves, echoing the large red disk. The right background is off-white, while the left and upper areas are nearly pure black. The person and plant overlap this sharp division, so their edges alternately disappear and reappear through contrast. There is no shading, texture, setting, or conventional depth. Even the features of the face are not drawn inside the silhouette; they are recognized through the precise shape of its edge. The hand is simplified to a few rounded fingers around the stem. The flat disk adds a warm visual weight that balances the vertical plant and tall black form. The frame is quiet despite high contrast. Large uninterrupted shapes dominate, with the little leaf and berry details providing a delicate counterpoint. The composition reads simultaneously as a portrait and an optical puzzle of positive and negative space. Its emotional effect is reserved and suggestive, created by a small gesture and the carefully controlled meeting of red circle, black profile, and off-white field rather than by expression or elaborate detail.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形极简图形插画，只由黑、暖米白和一处鲜红组成。一个纯黑侧面人物占据左侧和中央大部。额、鼻、唇和下巴的边缘在脸后红圆盘前成为清脆的负空间边界。圆盘位于中央略左，一段圆弧被黑剪影遮住。右下附近，一只黑手竖握细植物茎。几片尖黑叶从茎上分枝。上部叶旁一颗小红圆花或果呼应大红盘。右背景是米白，左侧与上方近乎纯黑。人与植物跨越这道锐利分界，边缘随着反差交替消失与重现。没有明暗塑造、肌理、场景或常规纵深。脸部内部连五官也未描画，只靠准确外缘认出。手简化为几根围住茎的圆润手指。平面红盘增添暖视觉重量，平衡竖植物和高黑体块。尽管反差高，画面安静。大片连续形状占主导，小叶与红点提供纤细对位。构图同时是一张侧像，也是正负空间的视觉谜。其情绪克制且暗示性强，由小手势和红圆、黑侧脸、米白域的精密相接创造，而非表情或繁复细节。
style_prompt_en: Minimal graphic illustration reduces a scene to a few flat, precisely fitted silhouettes in black, off-white, and one saturated red. Positive and negative space share responsibility for defining forms; an edge may vanish into one field and reappear against another. A large circular color mass balances a thin branching line and a small repeated accent. There is no modeled light, grain, or realistic perspective. Crisp contours and generous uninterrupted areas give every minor detail weight. The composition stays emotionally suggestive through placement and gesture rather than explicit expression. The effect is elegant, quiet, and optically playful, with strong hierarchy from large shapes to tiny marks.
style_prompt_zh: 极简图形插画把场景化为黑、米白与一处饱和红中少数精确嵌合的平面剪影。正负空间共同界定形体；边缘可在一块色域里消失，又在另一块前重现。大圆色块平衡细分枝线和重复的小重点。没有塑形光、颗粒或写实透视。清脆轮廓与宽阔连续区域让每个小细节有重量。构图以位置和手势暗示情绪，而非明确表情。效果优雅、安静且有视觉游戏感，大形到小痕的层级鲜明。
theme_en: A black profile holding a slender plant before a red circular form
theme_zh: 一幅黑色侧脸手持细枝，后方是一轮红色圆形
name: Noma Bar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
